searchText: I am starting to question how much success ETHLabs will have on influencing development. At the end of the day, they need to convince the all core devs to adopt the proposals they are putting forwsrd, like the quicker slot times eip for Hegota. It does seem like the EF has a lot of influence over the ACD governance process. Quicker slot times is going to be an interesting proving grounds for this theory that another R&D foundation with different opinions than the EF can have an impact. Quicker slot times are very popular with the community and users. However, it is not popular at all in the EF, whom are more concerned with the lean Ethereum transition. Shorter slot times make it even more challenging to do that transition due to needing to get ZK proving times down below the avg slot time.

excerpts.content:
I am starting to question how much success ETHLabs will have on influencing development. At the end of the day, they need to convince the all core devs to adopt the proposals they are putting forwsrd, like the quicker slot times eip for Hegota. It does seem like the EF has a lot of influence over the ACD governance process.

Quicker slot times is going to be an interesting proving grounds for this theory that another R&D foundation with different opinions than the EF can have an impact. Quicker slot times are very popular with the community and users. However, it is not popular at all in the EF, whom are more concerned with the lean Ethereum transition. Shorter slot times make it even more challenging to do that transition due to needing to get ZK proving times down below the avg slot time.
